heading: ஆங்கில மொழிபெயர்ப்பு
lines: The waste tract through which my lord has passed with eagerness is, they say, a place where the male deer thinking that the water in the pool is inadequate and wishing to make the entire water available for its mate to drink her fill, pretend to drink it thus said the confidante to her mistress. The indication is that the hero confronted with such a sight on his way will return home eagerly to rejoin his spouse. Balakrishna Mudaliyar
